toyota-2jz-gte.storia: Developed from the 1JZ with the stroke lengthened from 71.5 to 86 mm, it debuted in 1991 in the Toyota Aristo and powered the Supra A80 from 1993. Cast-iron block with seven main bearings, forged steel crankshaft, forged connecting rods and pistons cooled by oil jets under the crown. Two turbochargers in a sequential arrangement with an air-to-air intercooler. From 1997 it adopted VVT-i variable valve timing on the intake camshaft.
toyota-2jz-gte.limiti: The stock block and crankshaft withstand more than 700 CV. The original connecting rods are the first critical component, at roughly 700 to 800 CV. With forged rods and pistons, the stock block exceeds 1000 CV.
punti_deboli: Original sequential turbochargers with seals that become fragile after many years
Sequential system control valves (vacuum lines) prone to failure
Timing belt to be replaced at regular intervals (non-interference engine on early versions)
curiosita: The 1997 VVT-i version increases mid-range torque with the same declared power.
The sequential system runs the first turbo alone up to about 4000 rpm, then brings in the second.

versioni.nota: Limited by the Japanese manufacturers' 'gentlemen's agreement'; VVT-i from 1997

in_breve.testo: main bearings in the cast-iron block

introduction of VVT-i variable valve timing

affidabilita.motivo: Oversized block; known faults concern only the accessories of the sequential turbo system.

skoda-ea111-12-htp.storia: The EA111 1.2 HTP family is a three-cylinder petrol engine developed in Mladá Boleslav and produced from 2001. The first 40 kW version reached the Fabia in 2002, followed by the 12-valve variant in 2003. It features an aluminium block and cylinder head, a balance shaft and chain-driven valve gear, in SOHC and DOHC configurations. In 2014 Škoda announced that three million units had been produced.
punti_deboli: The hydraulic timing-chain tensioner may lose tension while the engine is stopped; chain jumping and rattling have been documented on some versions.
Early versions can experience high temperatures near the catalytic converter, affecting lubrication; later revisions introduced heat shielding.
skoda-ea111-12-htp.limiti: There is insufficient comparable evidence to establish a safe tuning power limit for standard internal components. Timing-chain condition, cooling and lubrication should be checked before performance modifications.
curiosita: In 2014 Škoda reported production of three million 1.2 HTP engines.
The 6-valve SOHC version preceded the 12-valve DOHC version.
manutenzione: Check for timing-chain noise during cold starts; replacement procedures depend on the engine code.
Follow the vehicle-specific service manual for oil and filter intervals; do not apply one generic interval to every variant.

lada-vaz-2106.storia: The VAZ-2106 is a four-cylinder petrol engine derived from the classic VAZ family. It first appeared in limited numbers in the 2103 in 1975 and was subsequently fitted to the 2106 and 2107. Compared with earlier engines, the bore increased to 79 mm while the stroke remained 80 mm. It has a cast-iron block, an aluminium cylinder head and an overhead camshaft driven by a duplex chain. In 1980 the Weber carburettor was progressively replaced by the Ozon.
punti_deboli: The lack of hydraulic lash adjusters requires valve-clearance adjustment; neglected adjustment can accelerate camshaft wear.
Oil leaks have been documented at the valve-cover gasket and crankshaft oil seals.
Failures of the thermostat, water pump or cooling fan can cause overheating and damage to the cylinder-head gasket.
lada-vaz-2106.limiti: No verified tuning power threshold is available for the original internal components. Before increasing engine speed or modifying fuelling, check valve clearances, timing-chain condition, gasket sealing and the cooling system.
curiosita: Displacement increased compared with the VAZ-2103 through a 79 mm bore while retaining the 80 mm stroke.
The VAZ-2121 engine fitted to the Niva is a separate variant and must not be confused with engine code VAZ-2106.
manutenzione: Inspection and adjustment of valve clearances are specified every 10.000 km in the maintenance schedule reported by the technical source.
Check timing-chain noise and tension, possible oil leaks and cooling-system operation.

lada-vaz-21126.storia: The VAZ-21126 debuted in 2007 in the Lada Priora and was subsequently fitted to the Kalina, Granta and some Samara 2 models. It is a four-cylinder engine with a cast-iron block, a 16-valve aluminium cylinder head, twin overhead camshafts and belt-driven valve timing with an automatic tensioner. Its design uses a lightweight Federal Mogul piston-and-connecting-rod assembly and Gates timing components. From 2018, some applications received pistons with valve reliefs to reduce the risk of piston-to-valve contact if the belt breaks.
punti_deboli: On versions built before the 2018 piston revision, a broken timing belt or seized idler can cause piston-to-valve contact.
Thermostat failures can disturb operating temperature and lead to overheating.
Unstable idle can be caused by the mass-airflow sensor, a dirty throttle body or idle-speed regulator; ignition-coil failures are also documented.
lada-vaz-21126.limiti: There is no verified safe tuning power threshold for the original internal components. Before modifying the intake, valve timing or engine speed, check the timing belt, idlers, water pump, cooling system and hydraulic lash adjusters.
curiosita: The Sport 21126-77 and NFR 21126-81 versions share the same basic architecture but use specific calibrations and components.
A piston revision was introduced in 2018 to reduce the risk of valve damage after a timing-belt failure.
manutenzione: Inspect the timing belt, idlers and water pump regularly, especially on engines built before the 2018 revision.
Hydraulic lash adjusters eliminate periodic valve-clearance adjustment; follow the oil and filter intervals specified for the particular vehicle.
